title: Russia frees US citizen Stephen Hubbard, state media reports
english: Russia has released 74-year-old American citizen Stephen Hubbard, who was previously sentenced to nearly seven years in prison for allegedly fighting for Ukraine. The release follows discussions between Russian officials and a US envoy, alongside a new agreement concerning Russian diesel exports. Hubbard, who had been classified as wrongfully detained by the US, is expected to return to America for medical treatment.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን በኩል ተዋግቷል በሚል ክስ ቀርቦበት የነበረውን የ74 ዓመቱን አሜሪካዊ እስጢፋኖስ ሁባርድን ለቃለች። ሁባርድ ከዚህ ቀደም ወደ ሰባት ዓመት የሚጠጋ እስራት ተፈርዶበት የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በአሜሪካ እና በሩሲያ መካከል በተደረገው ድርድር መሰረት ከእስር ተፈቷል። ይህ መለቀቅ የተከናወነው ሩሲያ ወደ ውጭ የምትልከውን ናፍጣ በተመለከተ ከተደረገ አዲስ ስምምነት ጋር በተያያዘ ነው። ጤንነታቸው በአንጻራዊ ሁኔታ የተዳከመው ሁባርድ ለህክምና ወደ አሜሪካ እንደሚሄዱ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Raashiyaan lammii Ameerikaa umuriin isaanii 74 kan ta'an Stephen Hubbard, waraana Yukreen keessatti hirmaate jedhamanii waggaa torbaatitti hidhamanii turan gadhiifteetti. Gadhiifamuun isaanii kun marii jila Ameerikaa fi mootummaa Raashiyaa gidduutti taasifamee fi dhimma ergaa boba'aa (diesel) Raashiyaa irratti waliigaltee haaraa erga godhamee booda kan raawwatame dha. Hubbard kanneen mootummaan Ameerikaa sirrii miti jedhee hidhamaniin keessaa tokko turan, yeroo ammaa yaalamuu isaanii dura gara Ameerikaatti kan deebi'an ta'uun ibsameera.

Police are currently investigating the motive behind this rare and violent incident against a government representative.

title: LeBron James’s 76ers beat NY Knicks on NBA’s opening night at MSG
english: LeBron James began his 24th NBA season by leading his new team, the Philadelphia 76ers, to a 106-100 victory over the defending champion New York Knicks. The game took place at Madison Square Garden during the Knicks' championship ring ceremony. Tyrese Maxey was the top scorer for the 76ers, while James contributed 14 points and seven assists to spoil the celebration.

oromo: LeBron James yeroo 24ffaaf tapha NBA jalqabeen, garee isaa haaraa Philadelphia 76ers hoogganuun mo'ataa waggaa darbee New York Knicks 106-100 injifateera. Taphi kun kan taasifame yeroo Knicks baddee injifannoo isaanii kabajachaa turanitti magaala New York keessatti. Tyrese Maxey qabxii olaanaa garee 76ersif yoo galchu, James ammoo qabxii 14 fi gargaarsa 7 godhuun injifannoo garee isaa mirkaneesseera.

title: Lula, Bolsonaro seek to disqualify each other ahead of Brazil runoff
english: As Brazil's presidential runoff election approaches, both Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and his rival have filed legal requests to disqualify each other. Bolsonaro’s camp alleges that Lula misused government resources to send mass political messages, while Lula’s team claims that Meta manipulated algorithms to unfairly damage his campaign. The Superior Electoral Court is now managing these competing complaints as the two candidates compete in a very tight race.

title: Italy approves sweeping security measures in response to protests
english: The Italian government has introduced strict security measures, including deploying 500 soldiers to Milan and implementing harsher prison sentences for violent protesters. These actions follow recent riots in northern cities caused by public frustration over high inflation, expensive energy, and low wages. The new laws also hold parents financially responsible for vandalism committed by their children and expand police authority to detain potentially dangerous teenagers.

title: Elon Musk says SpaceX and Tesla exploring largest merger in history
english: Elon Musk has announced that his companies, SpaceX and Tesla, are investigating a potential merger to combine their expertise in artificial intelligence and manufacturing. If the deal proceeds, it would create the largest corporate union in history with a valuation exceeding $3 trillion. However, Musk emphasized that the merger is not guaranteed, as it requires approval from a majority of Tesla shareholders.
amharic: ኢሎን ማስክ የሁለቱን ኩባንያዎች የጠፈር ምርምር ድርጅት (SpaceX) እና የኤሌክትሪክ መኪና አምራቹን (Tesla) ለማዋሃድ እየተወያዩ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውህደት ከተፈጠረ ከ3 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በላይ ዋጋ ያለው ትልቁ የንግድ ኩባንያ ይሆናል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። ይሁን እንጂ ውሳኔው የመጨረሻ እንዳልሆነ እና የቴስላ ባለአክሲዮኖች ድምጽ እንደሚያስፈልገው ማስክ አብራርተዋል።
oromo: Elon Musk dhaabbileen isaa SpaceX fi Tesla ogeessummaa isaanii teeknooloojii fi kalaqaa irratti walitti mufachuun tokko ta'uu akka danda'an beeksiseera. Walitti makamuun kun yoo milkaa'e, gurguddoo daldalaa seenaa keessatti mul'atan keessaa isa guddaa fi gatiin isaa tiriliyoona 3 ol kan ta'u ta'a. title: Elon Musk says Tesla-SpaceX merger being considered
english: Elon Musk is currently exploring the possibility of merging his two major companies, Tesla and SpaceX. While special committees have been formed to evaluate the idea, a final decision has not been reached and shareholder approval would be required.

title: Why former FDLR fighters are returning to Rwanda
english: Former FDLR fighters are choosing to leave the armed group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to return home to Rwanda. Upon arrival, these individuals go through a rehabilitation process at the Mutobo Demobilisation and Reintegration Centre, which helps them transition back into civilian life. The program provides essential support such as medical care, psychological counseling, and civic education to help them overcome the misinformation they were told while in the forest.
amharic: የቀድሞ የኤፍ.ዲ.ኤል.አር (FDLR) ታጣቂዎች በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የሚገኘውን ታጣቂ ቡድን ለቀው ወደ ሩዋንዳ በመመለስ ላይ ናቸው። ወደ ሀገራቸው ሲመለሱም በሙቶቦ የጠመንጃ ማስረከቢያና ማህበረሰብ ውስጥ መዋሃጃ ማዕከል በመግባት ወደ ሲቪል ህይወት ለመመለስ የሚያስችል ስልጠና ይወስዳሉ። ማዕከሉ የቀድሞ ታጣቂዎቹ በጫካ ውስጥ በነበሩበት ጊዜ የተነገራቸውን የተሳሳተ መረጃ እንዲያርሙ እና ከህብረተሰቡ ጋር እንዲዋሃዱ የህክምና፣ የስነ-ልቦና እና የዜግነት ትምህርት ድጋፍ ይሰጣል።
oromo: Waraanni duraanii FDLR jedhamu kanneen biyya Koongoo keessa turan, harka kennatanii gara biyya isaanii Ruwaandaatti deebi'aa jiru. Namoonni kun erga deebi'anii booda, giddugala 'Mutobo' jedhamu keessatti deebi'anii jireenya idilee namoota nagaa waliin jiraachuuf leenjii fi deeggarsa argatu. Giddugalichi fayyaa, gorsa sammuu fi barnoota waa'ee biyyaa kennuun, soba isaan bosona keessa turanitti himamaa ture irraa akka bilisa bahan fi hawaasatti akka makaman gargaara.

title: King Charles welcomes Omani sultan, hails peace efforts in UK state visit
english: King Charles III hosted Sultan Haitham bin Tariq of Oman for a three-day state visit, marking the first such visit from an Omani leader in over four decades. The King commended Oman for its commitment to diplomacy and its role as a neutral mediator in the ongoing Middle East conflicts. During the visit, both leaders emphasized the importance of their strategic partnership, with upcoming talks expected to cover security, trade, and regional stability.

oromo: Mootichi Chaarls sadaffaan, Sultaana Omaan Haaytam biin Taariq guyyoota sadiif turu daawwannaa mootummaatiin biyya Ingilizitti simatanii jiru. Mootichis, Omaan naannawa Baha Giddu galeessaa keessatti nagaa buusuuf fi karaa diippilomaasii fayyadamuuf carraaqqii gootuuf dinqisiifannaa ibsaniiru. Daawwannaan kun hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii keessattuu dhimmoota nageenyaa fi daldalaa cimsuuf kan gargaaruudha.

english: A small aircraft recently crashed onto a heavily traveled road in San Jose, California, an event that was recorded by a nearby dashboard camera. The footage has since been released to the public, showing the dramatic impact.

oromo: San Hoosee, Kaalifoorniyaatti xiyyaaraan tokko daandii konkolaataa namoonni itti baay'atan irratti kukkulee bu'eera. Gidduu galeessa kanaan, namoonni xiyyaaricha keessa turan sadanuu miidhaa salphaa qofaan lubbuun hafan. Gochi kunis suuraa kaameraa konkolaataa biraa irratti galfamee jira.

title: Trump and Zelensky appear at loggerheads despite Oslo optimism
english: Despite a recent meeting between Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Donald Trump’s envoy in Oslo, tensions between the two leaders remain high. Trump has publicly criticized Zelensky with harsh language, leading to concerns about the future of US support for Ukraine. While analysts suggest Trump's stance could shift as it has in the past, the current relationship appears increasingly strained and uncertain.
amharic: በኦስሎ የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዚዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ እና የዶናልድ ትራምፕ ልዑክ ቢገናኙም፣ በሁለቱ መሪዎች መካከል ያለው አለመግባባት አሁንም ቀጥሏል። ትራምፕ በዘለንስኪ ላይ የሚሰነዝሩት ጠንካራ ትችት ለዩክሬን የሚደረገው የአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ አጠያያቂ እንዲሆን አድርጓል። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት ትራምፕ አቋማቸውን ሊቀይሩ ቢችሉም፣ አሁን ያለው ግንኙነት እጅግ የተወጠረ እና ግልጽ ያልሆነ ሆኗል።
oromo: Prezidaantii Yukreen Voloodiimir Zeelenskiifi ergamaan Doonaald Traamp Oosloo keessatti wal arganii mari'atanis, gidduun isaanii ammayyuu guutummaatti hin fooyyofne. Traamp afaan ofii qara ta'een Zeelenskiin qeequun isaa, gargaarsi Ameerikaan Yukreeniif gootu gara fuulduraatti maal akka fakkaatu gaaffii keessa galcheera. Akka xiinxaltonni jedhanitti, Traamp kanaan dura akka godhan yaada isaanii jijjiiruu danda'anis, yeroo ammaa walitti dhufeenyi isaanii baay'ee kan ulfaateefi kan hin mirkanaa'inidha.

title: Trump commits more than $400m ahead of high-stakes midterm elections
english: President Donald Trump has pledged over $400 million to support Republican candidates in the upcoming midterm elections as his party works to retain control of Congress. Despite facing low public approval ratings and political challenges regarding the economy and international conflicts, Trump stated that a significant portion of these funds has already been utilized for advertising and voter outreach. He emphasized the critical nature of these elections, even as some party members remain concerned about his declining popularity.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ፓርቲያቸው በኮንግረስ ያለውን የበላይነት እንዲያስጠብቅ ለመርዳት በሚቀጥለው የመሃል ጊዜ ምርጫ ለሪፐብሊካን እጩዎች ከ400 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ እንደሚያወጡ አስታውቀዋል። የሀገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚ እና ዓለም አቀፍ ግጭቶች በምርጫው ላይ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደሩ ባሉበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ ትራምፕ የተወሰነውን የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ለቅስቀሳ እና ለምርጫ ስራዎች ማዋላቸውን ገልጸዋል። ምንም እንኳን የተወሰኑ የፓርቲው አባላት በፕሬዝዳንቱ ዝቅተኛ የህዝብ ተቀባይነት ምክንያት ቢሰጉም፣ ትራምፕ ይህ ምርጫ በሀገሪቱ ታሪክ እጅግ ወሳኝ እንደሆነ አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaard Traamp paartiin isaa to'annoo Koongirasii akka itti fufuuf, filannoo giddu-galeessaa dhufu irratti kaadhimamtoota Ripabliikanii gargaaruuf doolaara miiliyoona 400 ol akka ramadan beeksisaniiru. Dinagdee fi waldhabdee idil-addunyaa irratti hundaa'ee yaaddoon jiruus, Traamp maallaqa kana keessaa guddinni isaa beeksisuu fi sagalee walitti qabuuf ooluu isaa ibsaniiru. Miseensonni paartii tokko tokko jaalatamummaan pireezidaantichaa gadi bu'uun isaa isaan yaaddessus, Traamp filannoon kun seenaa biyyattii keessatti murteessaa ta'uu dubbataniiru.

title: PSG score late to sink Barcelona 4-2 in Champions League blockbuster
english: Paris Saint-Germain defeated Barcelona 4-2 in an exciting Champions League match at the Parc des Princes. Late goals from Vitinha and Fabian Ruiz secured the win for the French side, ending Barcelona's long unbeaten streak this season. Despite the victory, PSG suffered injuries to key players Ousmane Dembele and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.
amharic: ፓሪስ ሴንት ዠርሜን በቻምፒየንስ ሊግ ጨዋታ ባርሴሎናን 4 ለ 2 በሆነ ውጤት አሸንፏል። በጨዋታው መገባደጃ ላይ በቪቲኛ እና ፋቢያን ሩይዝ የተቆጠሩ ግቦች የፈረንሳዩን ክለብ አሸናፊ አድርገዋል። ባርሴሎና በዚህ የውድድር ዘመን የነበረውን ያለመሸነፍ ጉዞ ያቆመው ይህ ውጤት በፒኤስጂ በኩል በኦስማን ደምቤሌ እና በክቪቻ ክቫራትስኬሊያ ላይ የደረሰውን ጉዳት ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Paaris Saint-Jeermeen tapha Chaampiyoons Liigii irratti Baarseloonaa 4-2 ta'ee injifateera. Gooliin dhumarratti Viitiiniyaa fi Faabiyaan Ruwiiz galchan taphicha garee Faransaayiif moohataaf gumaachaniiru. Injifannoo kana keessatti Baarseloonaan asoosamaa ture kan yeroo dheeraaf hin injifatamin dhaabateera; ta'us, PSG'n ijoollee kubbaa miilaa gurguddoo ta'an kan akka Ousmaan Dembelee fi Khviichaa Kvaraatskeliyaa miidhamuu isaaniin miidhaa qabateera.

title: US food importer sues Trump over 50 percent tariffs on Canadian goods
english: A New Jersey-based food importer, Gellert Global Group, has filed a lawsuit against President Trump regarding his imposition of 50 percent tariffs on Canadian goods. The company contends that the President misused an outdated law to bypass Congress, causing significant financial strain and supply chain disruptions. The legal challenge argues that these trade penalties are unjustified, particularly because they apply to unrelated products like cheese due to disputes involving other industries.
amharic: ጄለርት ግሎባል ግሩፕ የተባለ የአሜሪካ የምግብ አስመጪ ድርጅት፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ የጣሉት የ50 በመቶ የጉምሩክ ቀረጥ ህገ-ወጥ ነው በማለት ክስ መስርቷል። ኩባንያው ፕሬዝዳንቱ የኮንግረስን ፈቃድ ሳያገኙ እጅግ ጥንታዊ የሆነ ህግን በመጠቀም እነዚህን ቀረጥ በመጣላቸው ከፍተኛ ወጪ እና የንግድ መስተጓጎል እንደገጠማቸው ይከራከራል። የህግ ባለሙያዎችም ፕሬዝዳንቱ ይህን መሰል ስልጣን ያለ ገደብ መጠቀም እንደሌለባቸው ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Dhaabbanni ergaa nyaataa Ameerikaa Gellert Global Group jedhamu, pirezidaanti Donald Traamp meeshaalee Kaanaadaa irratti gibira dhibbeentaa 50 ta'u buusuu isaanii mormuun himata baneera. Dhaabbatichi, pirezidaantichi hayyama koongiresii malee seera durii fayyadamuun gibira kana buusuun isaanii gatii meeshaalee akka dabale fi walitti dhufeenya daldalaa akka miidhe ibseera. title: PSG and Barcelona fans divided over politics in football amid Paris riots
english: As Paris Saint-Germain prepares to play Barcelona, fans are debating the role of politics within professional football. oromo: PSG fi Barcelona tapha Champions League taphachuuf qophaa'aa jiran kanatti, fansiin kubbaa miilaa irratti yaada adda addaa qabu. title: Houthi media report more air strikes on Taiz
english: Media outlets linked to the Houthi group reported that three airstrikes hit the al-Nashma region within Yemen's Taiz province. These attacks specifically targeted the al-Ma’afer district. No further details regarding the extent of the damage or potential casualties have been provided.
amharic: ከሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸው ሚዲያዎች በየመን ታኢዝ ግዛት በሚገኘው አል-ማአፈር ወረዳ ሶስት የአየር ጥቃቶች መፈጸማቸውን ዘግበዋል። ጥቃቶቹ አል-ናሽማ በተባለ አካባቢ ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ነበሩ። ስለደረሰው ጉዳት መጠን ወይም ስለ ሰለባዎች እስካሁን የተገለጸ ዝርዝር መረጃ የለም።
oromo: Miidiyaaleen garee Huutii waliin walqabatan akka gabaasanitti, naannoo Ta'iz kan Yaman keessatti argamu aanaa Al-Ma'afer jedhamu irratti haleellaan xiyyaaraa sadii raawwatameera. Haleellaan kun kan xiyyeeffate naannoo Al-Nashma jedhamu irratti dha. Miidhaa gahe ykn namoota miidhaman irratti odeeffannoon dabalataa ammaaf hin kennamne.

title: Pro-Palestinian Hasidic religious worker accused of hate crimes faces deportation to Israel
english: Yehonatan Ovadia, a 35-year-old Hasidic religious worker, is being detained in New York and faces deportation to Israel. Although immigration officials initially approved his visa extension, they revoked the decision shortly after, reportedly due to his outspoken pro-Palestinian stance. He is currently held by federal authorities while his legal status remains uncertain.
amharic: የ35 ዓመቱ የአይሁድ ሃይማኖት አገልጋይ የሆናታን ኦቫዲያ፣ በኒውዮርክ ታስሮ ወደ እስራኤል ሊባረር እንደሚችል ተገልጿል። የኢሚግሬሽን ባለስልጣናት መጀመሪያ ላይ የቪዛ ማራዘሚያውን ቢፈቅዱለትም፣ ከገለጹት የፍልስጤም ደጋፊ አቋም ጋር በተያያዘ ውሳኔውን እንደቀየሩት ይነገራል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በፌዴራል ባለስልጣናት ቁጥጥር ስር ሆኖ የህጋዊ ሁኔታው በውዝግብ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hojjetaan amantii Yihuudii kan ta'e Yehonatan Ovadia, magaalaa New Yorkitti qabamee gara Israa'elitti deebi'uuf dirqamaa jira. Mootummaan Amerikaa jalqaba hayyama visa isaa dheeressus, boodarra yaadota isaa kan deggeran Palestiinii irraa kan ka'e murticha haqee jira. Amma inni harka humnoota mootummaa federaalaa jala kan jiru yoo ta'u, haalli seeraa inni keessa jiru ifa miti.

title: Hegseth confirms he visited Israel, spoke to Netanyahu
english: US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth recently traveled to Israel to meet with American military personnel stationed there. During his visit, he held a private discussion with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Hegseth confirmed the meeting took place but declined to share any specific details about the topics discussed.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የጦር ሚኒስትር ፒት ሄግሴዝ በቅርቡ እስራኤልን በመጎብኘት እዚያ የሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ወታደሮችን አነጋግረዋል። በጉብኝታቸው ወቅት ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ጋር በግል ተገናኝተው መወያየታቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። ሆኖም ሚኒስትሩ በውይይታቸው ወቅት የተነሱትን ነጥቦች በዝርዝር ከመናገር ተቆጥበዋል።

Imala isaanii kanaanis muummicha ministeeraa Benjaamin Nataanyaahuu waliin dhimma dhuunfaa irratti mari'ataniiru. title: 'Great result for Canada', says Carney as Alberta votes to reject separatism
english: Alberta has decisively voted against separating from Canada, with over two-thirds of voters choosing to remain part of the nation. Prime Minister Mark Carney welcomed the outcome, emphasizing the importance of national unity and shared goals. Provincial Premier Danielle Smith acknowledged the result, stating that Albertans prefer to strengthen their province within a unified Canada.
amharic: የአልበርታ ነዋሪዎች ከካናዳ የመገንጠልን ሃሳብ በአብላጫ ድምፅ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ከሁለት ሶስተኛ በላይ የሚሆኑት መራጮች በካናዳ ህብረት ውስጥ ለመቆየት መወሰናቸውን ተከትሎ፣ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ ውጤቱን አድንቀዋል። የክልሉ መሪ ዳንኤል ስሚዝ የህዝቡን ውሳኔ በመቀበል፣ አልበርታ በአንድነት በምትቀጥል ካናዳ ውስጥ የበለጠ ጠንካራ እንደምትሆን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Uummanni Albartaa biyya Kanadaa irraa adda ba'uuf dhihaate ture sagalee caalmaan kufaa gochuun keessa turuuf murteessaniiru. Muummee Ministiraa Maark Kaarnii bu'aa argame kana dinqisiifachuu fi tokkummaan biyyaa barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Hogganaan naannichaa Daaniyeel Ismiit, murtee uummataa kana erga fudhatanii booda, Albartaan biyya Kanadaa tokko keessatti guddachuu akka filatte dubbataniiru.

title: The political ads that don’t look like ads
english: US political campaigns are increasingly hiring social media influencers to promote their agendas through short, viral videos. These content creators are often paid small amounts to make political messaging appear like authentic, organic content. Because these posts lack clear disclosure, many viewers are unaware they are watching paid political advertisements.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፖለቲካ ዘመቻዎች አጀንዳቸውን ለማስፋፋት በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ተፅዕኖ ፈጣሪዎችን በስፋት እየቀጠሩ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ግለሰቦች ለአጭር እና በፍጥነት በሚሰራጩ ቪዲዮዎች አማካኝነት የፖለቲካ መልእክቶችን እንደ ተራ የዕለት ተዕለት ይዘት እንዲመስሉ ተደርገው ይሰራሉ። ይሁን እንጂ ማስታወቂያዎቹ የሚከፈልባቸው ስለመሆናቸው ግልጽ መረጃ ስለሌለ ተመልካቾች በፖለቲካዊ ቅስቀሳ እየተሳተፉ መሆኑን አያውቁም።
oromo: Duulonni siyaasaa Ameerikaa ajandaa isaanii babal'isuuf midiyaa hawaasaa irratti namoota dhiibbaa uumuu danda'an (influencers) fayyadamaa jiru. Namoonni kunneen vidiyoo gaggabaaboo fi saffisaan tamsa'an fayyadamuun ergaa siyaasaa akka qabiyyee namoonni ofii isaanii uumanitti fakkeessuuf kaffaltii xiqqoo fudhatu. Haa ta'u malee, qabiyyee kana keessatti gorsuun inni beeksisa kaffaltii qabu ta'uu isaa waan hin ibsamneef, namoonni daawwatan beeksisa siyaasaa ilaalaa akka jiran hin hubatan.

title: UK to deploy fighter jets to defend Saudi Arabia
english: The British government has announced that it will station Typhoon fighter jets in Saudi Arabia to help defend the kingdom. This decision comes in response to increasing and unacceptable attacks launched by Houthi rebels from Yemen. UK officials described the ongoing hostility from the group as an intolerable escalation of regional violence.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት የሳውዲ አረቢያን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ታይፉን ተዋጊ ጄቶችን ወደ ሀገሪቱ እንደሚልክ አስታውቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው በየመን ሁቲ አማፂያን እየተፈጸሙ ያሉትን ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች ለመከላከል ነው። የብሪታንያ ባለስልጣናት አማፂያኑ እየፈጸሙት ያለውን የጥቃት እርምጃ ተቀባይነት የሌለው እና አደገኛ ድርጊት ሲሉ ገልጸውታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Biritishii nageenya Sa’udii Arabiyaa eeguuf jecha xiyyaarota waraanaa gosa 'Typhoon' gara biyyattii akka ergu beeksiseera. Murteen kun kan fudhatame, finxaaleyyii Huutii kan Yaman keessa jiran miidhaa geessisaa jiraniin wal-qabatee dha. Hoggantoonni Biritishii gocha gareen kun raawwataa jiru kan hin danda’amne fi guutummaa naannichaa kan jeequ ta’uu ibsaniiru.

title: Oxfam analysis finds Peru’s richest captured 42 percent of all new wealth
english: A recent Oxfam report reveals that Peru’s wealthiest 1 percent gained 42 percent of the country's new wealth between 2019 and 2025, while the poorest half of the population received only 1.4 percent. The study highlights significant public frustration, with a large majority of citizens believing that the government serves elite interests rather than the general public. Experts argue that these rising economic disparities are undermining trust in democratic institutions and fueling demands for policy reforms to ensure fairer wealth distribution.
amharic: የኦክስፋም የቅርብ ጊዜ ሪፖርት እንደሚያሳየው በ2019 እና በ2025 መካከል በፔሩ ከተፈጠረው አዲስ ሀብት 42 በመቶው በሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ ባለጸጋ በሆኑ 1 በመቶ ሰዎች እጅ ገብቷል፤ በዚሁ ወቅት የህዝቡ ድሃው ግማሽ ድርሻ ደግሞ 1.4 በመቶ ብቻ ነበር። ይህ መረጃ የሀገሪቱ የኢኮኖሚ ክፍተት እየሰፋ መሄዱን እና አብዛኛው የፔሩ ህዝብ መንግስት ለጥቂት ባለስልጣናት እና ባለጸጎች ብቻ እንደሚሰራ የሚያሳይ ነው። የኢኮኖሚ አለመመጣጠኑ በዴሞክራሲያዊ ተቋማት ላይ ያለውን እምነት እየሸረሸረ በመሆኑ፣ ህዝቡ የመንግስት ጣልቃ ገብነት እንዲኖር እና የሀብት ክፍፍሉ ፍትሃዊ እንዲሆን እየጠየቀ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gabaasni Oxfam dhiheenya kana bahe akka agarsiisutti, giddu gala bara 2019 fi 2025tti qabeenyi biyyattii haaraan 42% kan fudhatame %1 qabeenya qabeeyyii ol’aanaatiin yoo ta’u, walakkaan hawaasaa hiyyeeyyii ta’an garuu qabeenya haaraa keessaa kan argatan 1.4% qofa. Qorannoon kun akka agarsiisutti lammiileen baay’een mootummaan bu’aa qabeeyyii fi namoota dhiibbaa qaban qofaaf akka hojjetu amanu. Guddinni wal-qixxummaa dhabuu kun amantii ummanni sirna demokrasii irraa qabu akka laafisuu fi mootummaan jijjiirama siyaasaa fi dinagdee akka fidu barbaachisaa ta’uu ibsameera.

title: Can a humanitarian crisis in Gaza be averted?
english: The World Food Programme has announced it must reduce aid in Gaza due to a critical lack of funding. Despite previous ceasefire efforts, ongoing military actions have prevented improvements in the region's humanitarian conditions. These cuts will leave approximately half a million Palestinians without essential food assistance as the situation continues to worsen.
amharic: የዓለም የምግብ ፕሮግራም የገንዘብ እጥረት በማጋጠሙ በጋዛ የሚሰጠውን እርዳታ መቀነስ እንዳለበት አስታውቋል። የቀድሞ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቶች ቢደረጉም፣ ቀጣይነት ያለው ወታደራዊ ጥቃት በክልሉ ያለውን የሰብአዊ ሁኔታ ማሻሻል አልቻለም። ይህ የእርዳታ ቅነሳ ግማሽ ሚሊዮን የሚሆኑ ፍልስጤማውያንን አስፈላጊ የምግብ ዕርዳታ ሳያገኙ እንዲቀሩ ያደርጋቸዋል።
oromo: Sagantaan Nyaata Addunyaa (WFP) hanqina maallaqaa cimaa mudateen gargaarsa Gaza keessatti taasisu hir'isuu akka qabu beeksiseera. Waraana dhaabsisuuf yaaliiwwan duraan godhaman iyyuu, gochi waraanaa itti fufee waan jiruuf haalli namoomaa naannichaa fooyya'uu hin dandeenye. Hir'inni gargaarsa kanaa, haala jiru sanaan namoonni kuma dhibba shan ta'an gargaarsa nyaataa barbaachisaa ta'e akka dhaban taasisa.

title: Tigray’s Liberation Must End in Freedom
english: The article argues that while the Pretoria Agreement effectively ended large-scale fighting in Tigray, it failed to address the root causes and structural grievances of the conflict. It highlights how the TPLF and Tigrayan leadership have struggled to transition from military mobilization to a sustainable political strategy, leading to internal fractures and political instability. Consequently, Tigray remains in a precarious state where the lack of a unified political vision hinders both genuine peace and the ability to hold perpetrators of violence accountable.

title: North Korea publishes photos of Kim Jong Un - why do rumours of his death keep coming back?
english: North Korean state media recently released photos of leader Kim Jong Un appearing healthy during an exhibition, contradicting baseless rumors of his death from a brain hemorrhage. These false reports, which were sparked by an unverified claim from a Chinese dissident, follow a long pattern of speculation surrounding the secretive nation's leadership. Pezeshkian further advocated for regional security led by local powers and called for greater unity among Muslim nations to counter foreign interference.

title: France’s growing debt woes: How bond markets set countries’ borrowing costs
english: France is facing record-high borrowing costs as bond market investors grow increasingly concerned about the country's rising debt levels and internal political instability. Widespread social unrest and protests against government budget cuts have further damaged confidence in the nation's financial stability. Consequently, the government must spend more of its tax revenue on debt interest, leaving less funding available for critical public services.

title: US leaving oil-for-security approach, not Middle East: Envoy Tom Barrack
english: US diplomat Tom Barrack stated that the United States is ending its long-standing policy of trading security for oil and seeking to dominate Middle Eastern affairs. He acknowledged that past American attempts at regime change in the region have been ineffective and mistakes. Instead of withdrawing completely, the US is shifting its strategy to focus on a more limited and sustainable role in regional stability.

title: Zelenskyy to hold talks on Russia-Ukraine war with Witkoff, Europeans
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is meeting with US envoy Steve Witkoff and European leaders in Oslo to discuss potential paths toward ending the war with Russia. These talks occur amidst ongoing tensions regarding US support, as President Trump has criticized Zelenskyy's leadership and Ukraine faces recent deadly Russian air strikes. Despite disagreements over intelligence sharing and military aid, Zelenskyy recently held constructive talks with Secretary of State Marco Rubio to address these critical defense needs.

title: Trump’s approval ratings plummet: what that means for the US midterms
english: President Donald Trump’s approval ratings have reached an all-time low as voters express frustration over high living costs and the unpopular war with Iran. Recent polling indicates a significant shift toward the Democratic Party, which could lead to them gaining control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate in the upcoming midterm elections. If these trends continue, the Republican Party risks losing its current majorities in Congress, creating a difficult political environment for the president.

title: Exclusive: Full text of the Mecca defence pact signed by Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan
english: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have officially introduced the Mecca Defence Pact, a new military alliance similar to NATO. The agreement mandates that all three nations support each other with military resources if any member faces an external armed attack or threats to their sovereignty. Additionally, the pact promotes long-term cooperation in defense technology, military training, intelligence sharing, and the supply of equipment.

title: UK to deploy aircraft to protect Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks
english: The British government is sending Royal Air Force Typhoon fighter jets to Saudi Arabia to bolster its defenses. These aircraft are tasked solely with protecting Saudi cities and essential infrastructure from incoming Houthi air strikes. The UK government clarified that this deployment is strictly for defensive purposes and will not involve any offensive military operations against the Houthi forces.

title: Saudi Arabia executes man over crimes allegedly committed as a child
english: Saudi Arabia recently carried out the execution of Hassan Zaki al-Faraj, a man convicted for actions he allegedly took while still a child. Human Rights Watch reported that his conviction was based on a confession obtained through torture and solitary confinement, a claim the Saudi government denies. Concerns are now rising for other individuals facing similar sentences, as international groups argue that these judicial processes violate human rights standards.

oromo: Saudii Arabaayaan Hassan Zaki al-Faraj jedhamaniifi ijoollummaa isaanii keessa gocha raawwataniiru jedhamanii himataman irratti adaba du'aa raawwatteetti. Gareewwan mirga namoomaa akka gabaasanitti, adabni kun ragaa hiraarsaa (dararaa) fayyadamuun argame irratti kan hundaa'e yoo ta'u, mootummaan Saudiis himata kana fudhatama hin qabu jechuun haaleera. title: Israeli attacks kill four people in Gaza
english: At least four Palestinians lost their lives during Israeli military operations in the Gaza Strip on Tuesday. A married couple was killed in a targeted airstrike within Gaza City. Additionally, two other individuals, including a teenager, were fatally shot by Israeli forces in separate incidents in Khan Younis and the Zeitoun suburb.
amharic: ማክሰኞ ዕለት በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ አራት ፍልስጤማውያን በጋዛ ሰርጥ ተገድለዋል። በጋዛ ከተማ በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት አንድ ባልና ሚስት ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በተጨማሪም በካን ዩኒስ እና በዘይቱን ሰፈር በተፈጸሙ የተኩስ ልውውጦች አንድ ታዳጊ ወጣት እና ሌላ አንድ ግለሰብ መገደላቸውን የጤና ባለሙያዎች አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kibxata darbe haleellaa waraana Israa'elin Gaza keessatti namoonni Palestiinii hedduun ajjeefamaniiru. Haleellaa xiyyaaraa magaalaa Gaza keessatti raawwatameen abbaan warraa fi haati warraa ajjeefamaniiru. Kana malees, naannoo Khan Yunisii fi naannoo Zeitunitti dhukaasa waraana Israa'elin dargaggeessi tokko fi namni biraan tokko ajjeefamuu isaanii ogeeyyonni fayyaa ibsaniiru.

title: Iran warns citizens against travel to France, Belgium and Italy amid violent unrest
english: The Iranian government has issued a travel advisory urging its citizens to avoid visiting France, Belgium, and Italy due to escalating violent protests and civil instability. The demonstrations in these European nations are largely driven by a cost-of-living crisis and opposition to foreign policy, resulting in thousands of arrests and serious injuries. Iran's leadership has criticized the French government's heavy-handed response to these protesters, pointing to what they describe as hypocrisy in international human rights standards.
amharic: የኢራን መንግሥት በፈረንሳይ፣ በቤልጂየም እና በኢጣሊያ እየተካሄደ ባለው የሕዝብ ተቃውሞ እና አለመረጋጋት ሳቢያ ዜጎቹ ወደነዚህ አገራት ከመጓዝ እንዲቆጠቡ አስጠንቅቋል። በአውሮፓ አገራት የተቀሰቀሰው ይህ ተቃውሞ በኑሮ ውድነት እና በውጭ ግንኙነት ፖሊሲዎች የተነሳ የተፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች መታሰራቸውንና ለከባድ ጉዳት መዳረጋቸውን ዘገባዎች ያሳያሉ። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በፈረንሳይ መንግሥት በሰልፈኞች ላይ እየተወሰደ ያለውን እርምጃ በማውገዝ፣ ይህ ድርጊት አገሪቱ ከምትከተለው ዓለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ መብት አቋም ጋር የሚጋጭ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraan, biyyoota akka Faransaay, Beeljiyeemii fi Xaaliyaanii keessatti jeequmsi fi mormiin hammaachuu isaan wal-qabatee lammiileen isaa biyyoota kanneen akka hin deemne akeekkachiiseera. Mormiin biyyoota Awurooppaa kanneen keessatti ka'e kun gatii jireenyaa dabuu fi siyaasa alaa waliin kan wal-qabatu yoo ta'u, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman hidhamanii fi miidhaan cimaanis akka gahe gabaafameera. Hoggantoonni Iraan mootummaan Faransaay mormitoota irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachaa jiru qeequun, kunis sadarkaa mirga namoomaa addunyaa irratti ofitti amanamummaa dhabuu akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Seventh day of violent clashes between Albanian protesters and police
english: Albania is facing its seventh straight day of violent unrest as students and protesters continue to clash with police in Tirana. Demonstrators are calling for the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama, citing issues like corruption and poor educational conditions. Hundreds of people, including many police officers, have already been injured as security forces use water cannons and tear gas to control the crowds.
amharic: በአልባኒያ ዋና ከተማ ቲራና ተማሪዎችና ተቃዋሚዎች ከፖሊስ ጋር ግጭት ውስጥ ከገቡ ሰባት ቀናት ተቆጥረዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ በሙስና እና በዩኒቨርሲቲዎች መጥፎ ሁኔታ በመነሳሳት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኤዲ ራማ ስልጣን እንዲለቁ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ። በግጭቱ እስከ አሁን በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችና የፖሊስ አባላት ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን፣ የጸጥታ ኃይሎችም ውሃና እንባ አስለቃሽ ጋዝ በመጠቀም ሰላማዊ ሰልፈኞችን ለመቆጣጠር እየሞከሩ ነው።
oromo: Albaaniyaa keessatti barattoonnii fi hiriirtonni bulchiinsa magaalaa Tiraanaa keessatti poolisoota wajjin walitti bu'uun guyyaa torbaffaa isaa irra ga'eera. Hiriirtonni kun malaammaltummaa fi haala barnootaa fooyyeessuu dhabuu mormuun, ministirri muummee Eedii Raamaa aangoo gadhiisuu akka qaban gaafachaa jiru. Giddu galeessaan namoota dhibbaan lakkaa'aman fi poolisoonni hedduun miidhamaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, humnoonni nageenyaa bishaan humnaa fi gaazii imimmaaniin hiriirtota bittinneessuuf yaalii gochaa jiru.

title: Canadian tourist found guilty of animal cruelty after stealing Las Vegas flamingo from enclosure
english: A Canadian man has been convicted of animal cruelty after stealing a flamingo named Peachy from a Las Vegas hotel habitat while intoxicated. The tourist carried the bird to his hotel room, resulting in physical injuries to the animal, despite his claims that the act was intended as a prank. He is now awaiting sentencing and could potentially face up to five years in prison for his actions.
amharic: አንድ የካናዳ ዜጋ በስካር መንፈስ ውስጥ እያለ ከላስ ቬጋስ ሆቴል 'ፒቺ' የተባለች ፍላሚንጎ ወፍ በመስረቁ በእንስሳት ላይ ጭካኔ የተሞላበት ድርጊት ፈጽሟል ተብሎ ተፈርዶበታል። ተከሳሹ ወፏን አንገቷን ይዞ ወደ ሆቴል ክፍሉ በመውሰዱ ወፏ ላይ ጉዳት ደርሶባታል። ምንም እንኳን ድርጊቱ ለቀልድ እንደሆነ ቢገልጽም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ጥፋተኛ ብሎታል እናም እስከ አምስት ዓመት እስራት ሊቀጣ ይችላል።
oromo: Namni biyya Kanadaa tokko yeroo machii keessa turetti simbirroo 'Flamingo' jedhamtu kanneen 'Peachy' jedhaman hoteela Laas Veegas keessaa hatuun yakka bineensota irratti raawwatamee irra darbuun himatameera. Namichi kun simbirroo tana qabee gara kutaa hoteela isaa erga galee booda, simbirrottii irratti miidhaan qaamaa gaheera. Innis gochi kun taphaaf akka ta'e dubbatuus, mana murtichaan yakka qabaachuu isaa mirkaneeffatee hidha waggaa shanii hanga ta'u itti murtaa'uu danda'a.

title: Mission blasts off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
english: Japan has launched the Mars Moons Exploration mission, which aims to collect dust samples from the Martian moon Phobos and return them to Earth. The spacecraft is expected to reach the moon by 2027 to study its origins and terrain using a specialized rover. If successful, this project will provide the first-ever physical samples from the Martian system to be analyzed by scientists in terrestrial laboratories by 2031.
amharic: ጃፓን የማርስ ጨረቃ በሆነችው ፎቦስ ላይ አፈር በመሰብሰብ ወደ ምድር ለማምጣት የታቀደውን የጠፈር ተልዕኮ ወደ ህዋ አስወንጭፋለች። የጠፈር መንኮራኩሯ በ2027 ደርሳ የጨረቃዋን አመጣጥ እና አቀማመጥ ለማጥናት ታቅዷል። ይህ ተልዕኮ በስኬት ከተጠናቀቀ በ2031 የሳይንስ ሊቃውንት በማርስ ጨረቃ ላይ የተገኘ ቁሳቁስን በምድር ላብራቶሪዎች ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የመመርመር እድል ያገኛሉ።
oromo: Japan ergaa gara ji'a maarsi Fooboos jedhamtuutti qajeele qilleensa irra oolcheera, kunis biyyee achirraa fuudhee gara lafaatti deebisuuf kan kaayyeffatedha. Xiyyarri kun ji'a kana qorachuuf bara 2027 gahuun kan eegamu yoo ta'u, biyyee funaaname kana gara lafaatti deebisuun ammoo bara 2031 keessa ta'a. Kuni milkaa'inaan yoo raawwatame, saayintistoonni wantoota ji'a maarsi irraa dhufan lafa irratti akka qoratan carraa jalqabaa kenna.

title: Israel’s elections 2026 explained in maps and charts
english: On October 27, 2026, Israel will hold its sixth general election in seven years to select members for the 120-seat Knesset. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is attempting to secure another term amidst ongoing corruption trials and intense regional conflicts. While over seven million citizens are eligible to vote, the process is notable because millions of Palestinians living under Israeli control lack any participation in the system, and forming a stable majority coalition remains a difficult challenge.
amharic: እስራኤል በጥቅምት 27 ቀን 2026 ለ120 መቀመጫ ያለው ፓርላማ ስድስተኛ ጠቅላላ ምርጫዋን ታካሂዳለች። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በሙስና ክስ እና በክልላዊ ግጭቶች መካከል ለስልጣን ይወዳደራሉ። ከሰባት ሚሊዮን በላይ የሚሆኑ እስራኤላውያን ድምጽ ለመስጠት ብቁ ቢሆኑም፣ በእስራኤል ቁጥጥር ስር የሚኖሩ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ፍልስጤማውያን በምርጫው መሳተፍ አለመቻላቸው እና የፓርላማ አብላጫ ድምጽ ማግኘት አስቸጋሪ መሆኑ በምርጫው ላይ ትኩረት የሳቡ ጉዳዮች ናቸው።
oromo: Israa'el guyyaa Mudde 27, 2026 palamantii ishee ykn Knesseeti keessatti miseensota 120 filachuuf filannoo waliigalaa ja'affaa gaggeessiti. Ministirri Muummee Beniyaamin Netiyaahuuu himannaa malaammaltummaa fi waraana naannichaa keessatti qabaman gidduutti yeroo biraatiif filatamuu yaaluu jiru. Namoonni miliyoona torba ol ta'an sagalee kennuuf mirga kan qaban ta'us, namoonni miliyoonaan lakkaawwaman kan ta'an Falasxiinoota to'annoo Israa'el jala jiran sirna kana keessatti sagalee hin qaban; akkasumas mootummaa ykn ko'alishinii gadi dhaabuun filannoo kana keessatti rakkoo guddaa ta'ee itti fufeera.

title: US Supreme Court to hear case on race in school admissions
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has agreed to review a lawsuit involving selective middle schools in Maryland that challenges current admission policies. A group of parents alleges that the school district's selection process discriminates against Asian-American students in favor of Black and Latino applicants. The court will decide whether to revive the case, which was previously dismissed by lower courts that found no evidence of unfair bias.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት በመሪላንድ በሚገኙ የተመረጡ መለስተኛ ትምህርት ቤቶች የመግቢያ ደንብ ላይ የቀረበ ክስን ለመመልከት ተስማምቷል። የወላጆች ቡድን የትምህርት ቤቱ የመግቢያ ሥርዓት በእስያ ተወላጅ ተማሪዎች ላይ መድልዎ በማድረግ ጥቁር እና ላቲኖ ተማሪዎችን እንደሚደግፍ ይከራከራሉ። ፍርድ ቤቱ ቀደም ሲል በታችኛው ፍርድ ቤት ውድቅ የተደረገውን ይህንን ክስ እንደገና እንዲታይ ማድረግ አለመደረጉን ይወስናል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Ameerikaa, manneen barnootaa giddu-galeessaa Maryland keessatti qajeelfama galtee barattootaa irratti dhimma ka'e qorachuuf walii galeera. Gareen maatii tokko, sirni galtee mana barnootichaa barattoota gosaa biroo caalaa, barattoota 'Asian-American' ta'an irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jira jechuun himata dhiyeessaniiru. Mana murtichaa himata kanaan dura kutaalee mana murtii gadii irraa kufaatii argate kana irra deebi'ee ilaaluu fi dhiisuu isaa murteessa.

title: Japan launches historic mission to bring back Mars moon samples
english: Japan has officially started a five-year space mission aimed at visiting Phobos, one of the moons orbiting Mars. The goal of this uncrewed project is to gather soil samples and safely transport them back to our planet by 2031. This landmark endeavor would represent the first time in history that material from a Martian moon has been collected for scientific analysis.
amharic: ጃፓን ወደ ማርስ ጨረቃ አንዷ ወደሆነችው ፎቦስ የሚደረግ የአምስት ዓመት የጠፈር ምርምር ጉዞ ጀምራለች። የዚህ ያለ ሰው የሚከናወን ፕሮጀክት ዋና ዓላማ የአፈር ናሙናዎችን በመሰብሰብ በ2031 ወደ ምድር መመለስ ነው። ይህ ታሪካዊ ተልዕኮ ስኬታማ ከሆነ፣ ከማርስ ጨረቃ ናሙናዎች ተሰብስበው ለሳይንሳዊ ምርምር ሲቀርቡ የመጀመሪያው ይሆናል።
oromo: Jaappaan gara ji'a maarsii keessaa tokko kan taate 'Foobos' dhaqee qorannoo gochuuf waggaa shan kan turu ergama haaraa jalqabdeetti. Kaayyoon pirojektii namoota hin qabne kanaa, lafa ji'attii kanaa irraa biyyee sassaabanii bara 2031tti gara lafaatti deebisuudha. Ergamaan seena qabeessi kun yoo milkaa'e, yeroo jalqabaatiif biyyee ji'a maarsii irraa sassaabamee qorannoodhaaf gara lafaatti kan fidu ta'a.

title: Fourteen dead in illegal Colombian gold mine collapse
english: At least 14 people lost their lives following the collapse of an unauthorized gold mine in a secluded region of Colombia. Rescue operations have officially ended, leaving several others injured from the incident. Because the site is deep within a rainforest, it is only accessible via air or water travel.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ በምትገኝ ገለልተኛ አካባቢ ያለ ህገ-ወጥ የወርቅ ማዕድን በመደርመሱ ምክንያት ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በአደጋው በርካታ ሰዎች የቆሰሉ ሲሆን፣ የነፍስ አድን ስራውም በአሁኑ ወቅት ተቋርጧል። ቦታው ጥቅጥቅ ባለ ደን የተከበበ በመሆኑ በአውሮፕላን ወይም በጀልባ ብቻ መድረስ ይቻላል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa keessatti bakka buufata warqee seeraan alaa tokko kufuun lubbuun namoota 14 darbeera. Haala kanaan namoonni biroon hedduunis miidhamaniiru, akkasumas hojiin barbaachaafi oolchuu gadi dhiifameera. Bakki kun bosona baay'ee keessa waan argamuuf, karaa xiyyaaraa ykn dooniin qofa dhaquun danda'ama.

title: ‘Deliberate’ car ramming of Australian MP an isolated incident, police say
english: Australian independent lawmaker Helen Haines is in critical condition after being intentionally struck by a vehicle outside her office in Wangaratta. Police have arrested a 43-year-old man for the attack and stated that there is no broader threat to public safety. While the motive remains under investigation, officials confirmed the collision was a deliberate act rather than an accident.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያዋ የፓርላማ አባል ሄለን හේንስ በዋንጋራታ በሚገኘው ቢሯቸው ውጭ በመኪና ሆን ተብሎ ከተገጩ በኋላ በአስጊ ሁኔታ ላይ ይገኛሉ። ፖሊስ ጥቃቱን ፈጽሟል የተባለውን የ43 ዓመት ግለሰብ በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋለ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ድርጊት የተለየ እና ለህዝብ ተጨማሪ ስጋት የሌለው መሆኑን ገልጿል። ጥቃቱ በአደጋ ሳይሆን ሆን ተብሎ የተፈጸመ መሆኑ የተረጋገጠ ሲሆን፣ የድርጊቱ ዓላማ ግን እስካሁን በምርመራ ላይ ነው።
oromo: Miseensi paarlaamaa Awustiraaliyaa Helen Heens waajjira ishee fuulduratti konkolaataan yaadamee rukutamtee gandaa yaalamtuu keessa jirti. Poolisiin namicha umuriin isaa waggaa 43 ta’e to’annoo jala oolcheera; gochi kunis balaa tasaa osoo hin taane gocha hamaa ta’uu fi balaa biraa kan hin qabne ta’uu ibseera. Namichi kun maaliif akka kana godhe poolisiin qorachaa kan jiru yoo ta’u, miidhaan isheen irra geesee guddaa ta’uunis gabaafameera.

title: Curfew imposed in parts of central Paris and other cities after rioting across France
english: French authorities have introduced nighttime curfews and public gathering bans in Paris and several other major cities following widespread rioting and looting. The protests, which started as student-led demonstrations over school conditions, have resulted in over 2,500 arrests and significant injuries to both protesters and police. In response to the unrest, the government has empowered local mayors to enforce restrictions and is planning to hold those responsible for property damage financially accountable.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ በበርካታ ከተሞች በተቀሰቀሰው አመጽ እና ዝርፊያ ሳቢያ መንግስት በፓሪስ እና ሌሎች የሀገሪቱ ክፍሎች ላይ የሌሊት ሰዓት እላፊ ገደብ ጥሏል። በትምህርት ቤት ሁኔታዎች መሻሻል ጥያቄ የተጀመረው ተቃውሞ ወደ ሰፊ ብጥብጥ በማደጉ ከ2,500 በላይ ሰዎች ታስረዋል፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የፖሊስ አባላትም ተጎድተዋል። መንግስት በአካባቢው ከንቲባዎች አማካኝነት የሰዓት እላፊ ገደቦችን እንዲያስፈጽም ስልጣን የሰጠ ሲሆን፣ በንብረት ላይ ጉዳት ያደረሱ ግለሰቦችም ካሳ እንዲከፍሉ እንደሚደረግ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Faransaatti jeequmsa fi saamicha babal’ataa dhufeen walqabatee, mootummaan bulchiinsa Paariisii fi magaalota gurguddoo biroo keessatti labsii yeroo galgalaatti daangaa gandaa baaseera. Morman kun jalqaba haala barnootaa fooyyessuuf barattootaan kan eegale yoo ta'u, amma gara jeequmsaatti jijjiiramuun namoonni 2,500 ol hidhamaniiru, poolisonni 1,000 olis miidhamaniiru. Mootummaan magaalota keessatti kantiibonni ofii isaanii fedhii isaaniitiin daangaa kana akka labsan kan heyyame yoo ta'u, miidhaa qabeenyaa ga’eefis namoonni sababa ta’an akka kaffalan taasisus ibseera.

title: Five ways El Niño is affecting the weather around the world
english: The El Niño phenomenon is currently causing severe global weather disruptions, including record-breaking wildfires in Indonesia and an unusually intense hurricane season in the Pacific. Experts note that these extreme events are being worsened by higher ocean temperatures and shifting atmospheric conditions. With the situation expected to persist until at least 2027, many regions are facing significant risks to public health, safety, and infrastructure.
amharic: የኤል ኒኖ ክስተት በአሁኑ ወቅት በዓለም ዙሪያ ከፍተኛ የአየር ንብረት መዛባትን እያስከተለ ሲሆን፣ በተለይም በኢንዶኔዥያ የከፋ የደን ቃጠሎ እና በፓስፊክ ውቅያኖስ ደግሞ ያልተለመደ ኃይለኛ የዐውሎ ነፋስ ወቅት እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት እነዚህ ከፍተኛ የአየር ንብረት ክስተቶች በውቅያኖስ የሙቀት መጠን መጨመር እና በከባቢ አየር ለውጥ የተነሳ እየተባባሱ መጥተዋል። ሁኔታው ቢያንስ እስከ 2027 ድረስ ሊቀጥል ስለሚችል፣ ብዙ አካባቢዎች ለሕዝብ ጤና፣ ለደህንነት እና ለመሰረተ ልማት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ውስጥ ወድቀዋል።
oromo: Mudannoon El Niño yeroo ammaa kana addunyaa guutuu keessatti jijjiirama qilleensa hamaa uumaa jira; kanneen keessaa ibiddi bosonaa Indoneezhiyaa keessatti ka'e fi obomboleettiin Paasifikii keessatti uumame sadarkaa olaana irra ga'eera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, balaawwan kun bishaan galaanaa ho'achuu fi jijjiirama qilleensaan kan walqabatan yoo ta'u, miidhaan isaas hammaataa dhufeera. Haalli kun hanga bara 2027 itti fufa jedhame waan eegamuuf, naannooleen hedduun fayyaa uummataa, nageenyaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa irratti balaa cimaa keessa jiru.

title: ‘Release Epstein files’, protester interrupts JD Vance’s speech
english: During a campaign rally in North Carolina, a protester disrupted US Vice President JD Vance by calling for the disclosure of Jeffrey Epstein’s documents. Vance addressed the interruption with a joke, suggesting the demonstrator was an unauthorized individual who had crossed the border illegally. This occurred while Vance was speaking about immigration policies and border security efforts.
amharic: በሰሜን ካሮላይና በተካሄደ የቅስቀሳ ስብሰባ ላይ አንድ ተቃዋሚ የጄፍሪ ኤፕስታይን ሰነዶች ይፋ እንዲደረጉ በመጠየቅ የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስን ንግግር አቋርጠዋል። ቫንስ ለዚህ ጥያቄ በቀልድ መልክ ምላሽ ሲሰጡ፣ ተቃዋሚው ድንበር ጥሶ የገባ ሰው ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተናግረዋል። ይህ ክስተት የተከሰተው ቫንስ ስለ ኢሚግሬሽን እና ስለ ድንበር ደህንነት ጉዳዮች ንግግር እያደረጉ በነበረበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Kaarolayinaa kibbaatti walgahii duula filannoo irratti, namni tokko gadi bahee dokumentiin Jeferi Epistayin akka ifa bahu gaafachuun haasaa Istaayilii Veesi (JD Vance) addaan kutee jira. Veesinis deebii kenneen, namichi kun daangaa cabsee kan dhufe ta'uu danda'a jechuun qoosaniiru. Kunu kan ta'e Veesin waa'ee imaammata godaantotaa fi eegumsa daangaa irratti haasaa gochaa osoo jiranii dha.

title: Rashida Tlaib demands arrest of Israeli soldier linked to Hind Rajab death
english: US Representative Rashida Tlaib is urging the government to arrest an Israeli military commander currently in the United States who is linked to the 2024 death of five-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza. Tlaib argues that the US is legally obligated to investigate the officer for alleged war crimes based on reports from the Hind Rajab Foundation. The case became a major symbol of the conflict after recordings captured the young girl's desperate plea for help before she and the rescuers sent to find her were killed.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አባል ራሺዳ ትላይብ በአሁኑ ወቅት በአሜሪካ የሚገኝ እና እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 በጋዛ የ5 ዓመቷን ህጻን ሂንድ ራጃብን በመግደል የተጠረጠረ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ አዛዥ እንዲታሰር ጠይቀዋል። ትላይብ አሜሪካ በሂንድ ራጃብ ፋውንዴሽን መረጃ መሰረት ተጠርጣሪውን ለጦር ወንጀል ምርመራ የማቅረብ ህጋዊ ግዴታ አለባት ብለዋል። ህጻኗ ከመገደሏ በፊት ለእርዳታ የጠየቀችበት የድምጽ ቅጂ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከፍተኛ ቁጣን ቀስቅሶ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩም በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት የሲቪል ህዝቦች ለደረሰባቸው ጥቃት ምልክት ሆኗል።
oromo: Miseensi Mana Maree Bakka Buutota Ummata Amerikaa Raashida Tlaayib, ajajaan waraanaa Israa'el kan yeroo ammaa Amerikaa keessa jiru fi bara 2024 Gazaatti mucayyoo waggaa shan Hind Raajab ajjeese jedhamee shakkamu akka hidhamu gaafataniiru. Tlaayib akka jedhanitti, gabaasa 'Hind Rajab Foundation' irratti hundaa'uun, Amerikaan shakkamaa kana yakka waraanaatiin qorachuuf dirqama seeraa qabdi. Mucayyoon tun erga ajjeefamtee booda sagaleen gargaarsa gaafachaa turte addunyaa guututti mufannaa guddaa uumee kan ture yoo ta'u, dhimmi ishees waraana Gaza keessatti sivilonni irratti xiyyeeffannoon raawwatamaa jiruuf mallattoo ta'ee jira.

title: Hegseth meets Netanyahu in unannounced Israel visit
english: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced visit to Israel to meet with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. This meeting comes shortly after President Donald Trump publicly endorsed Netanyahu ahead of a highly competitive parliamentary election. While the administration has shown support, Vice President JD Vance clarified that he is not taking a stance on the Israeli vote.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ፒት ሄግሴት እስራኤልን ባልታወቀ ጉብኝት በማድረግ ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ጋር ተገናኝተዋል። ይህ ስብሰባ የተካሄደው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቅርቡ በሚካሄደው የእስራኤል ምርጫ ኔታንያሁን በይፋ ከደገፉ በኋላ ነው። ሆኖም ምክትል ፕሬዚዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ በእስራኤል የውስጥ ምርጫ ውስጥ ጣልቃ እንደማይገቡ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Ameerikaa Peet Hegseet gara Israa'el imaluudhaan Muummee Ministiraa Benyaamin Neetaanyaahuu waliin walarguufi. Walarguun kun kan ta'e erga Pirezidaant Doolaard Tiraamp filannoo Israa'el dhufuuf jiru irratti Neetaanyaahuun deggaruu isaanii ibsanii booda. Ta'us, Pirezidaant Itti-aanaan JD Vaans dhimma filannoo Israa'el keessa akka hin galleefi gama kamiyyuu akka hin degarre ibsaniiru.

title: Exiled critic of Rwandan president found beheaded in Uganda
english: Robert Kabera, an exiled Rwandan critic who operated a popular YouTube channel opposing President Paul Kagame, was discovered decapitated in a village near Kampala, Uganda. Ugandan police are actively investigating the murder, while his family suggests the killing was politically motivated by authorities in Rwanda. This incident follows a pattern of suspicious deaths involving Rwandan dissidents living abroad over the past decade.
amharic: የሩዋንዳውን ፕሬዝዳንት ፖል ካጋሜን በዩቲዩብ ቻናላቸው በይፋ ይተቹ የነበሩትና በስደት በኡጋንዳ ይኖሩ የነበሩት ሮበርት ካቤራ አንገታቸው ተቀልቶ በካምፓላ አቅራቢያ ተገኝተዋል። የኡጋንዳ ፖሊስ ግድያውን እያጣራ ሲሆን፣ የተጎጂው ቤተሰቦች ግድያው ከሩዋንዳ መንግስት ጋር በተያያዘ የፖለቲካ ተነሳሽነት እንዳለው ገልጸዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት ላለፉት ዓመታት በስደት በሚኖሩ የሩዋንዳ ተቃዋሚዎች ላይ ሲደርሱ ከነበሩ ተመሳሳይ ግድያዎች ጋር ተያይዞ ትልቅ ትኩረት ስቧል።
oromo: Mormaan mootummaa Ruwaandaa kan ta'anii fi biyya alaatti kan turan Roobert Kaaberaa, qabxiiwwan isaanii YouTube irratti mootummaa Paawul Kaagaamee mormuudhaan beekamu. Reeffi isaanii mataan irraa muramee magaalaa Kaampaalaa, Yugaandaa cinaatti argameera. Poolisiin Yugaandaa ajjeechaa kana qorachaa jiru yoo ta'u, maatiin isaa immoo ajjeechaan kun mootummaa Ruwaandaatiin kan raawwatame ta'uu shakku. Kunis mormitoonni Ruwaandaa biyya alaatti jiraatan gara fuulduraatti yeroo hedduu ajjeefamaa turan keessaa isa tokko ta'eera.

title: Iran war live: Trump says US hits Iran hard ‘economically and militarily’
english: President Donald Trump stated that the U.S. is pressuring Iran through both military actions and economic sanctions. Meanwhile, China has criticized the recent U.S.-Israeli strikes as an act of aggression, and Iran has warned that it may disrupt critical underwater communication cables in the Strait of Hormuz in retaliation. Additionally, Trump commended Vladimir Putin for keeping Russia out of the ongoing conflict.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጫና ማሳደሯን ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ቻይና በቅርቡ የተካሄደውን የአሜሪካና የእስራኤል ጥቃት እንደ ጥቃት በመፈረጅ አውግዛለች። ኢራን በበኩሏ የአሜሪካ ጥቃት ካልቆመ በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ ያሉትን የባህር በታች የቴሌኮም ገመዶች እንደምታጠቃ አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaard Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, Ameerikaan dhiibbaa diinagdee fi waraanaa Iiraan irratti gochuushee itti fufti. Gama biraatiin, Chainaan haleellaa Ameerikaa fi Israa'el Iiraan irratti raawwatan balaaleffatteetti. Iiraan ammoo, haleellaan kun yoo itti fufe, keebiloota quunnamtii bishaan jala jiran kan galaana Hoormuzi keessa jiran akka barbadeessitu akeekkachiiseetti.

title: Saudi-led coalition in Yemen warns Houthis against smuggling arms through, report of intercepting vessel
english: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen has issued a stern warning to Houthi rebels regarding the illegal transport of military supplies via sea vessels. Officials stated that these smuggling activities pose a significant threat to regional security and have called on local boat operators to stop assisting the group. This announcement followed reports that coalition forces successfully intercepted and destroyed a vessel carrying illicit weapons off the coast of Yemen.
amharic: በየመን የሚገኘው በሳውዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት፣ ሁቲዎች በባህር በኩል የጦር መሳሪያዎችን በድብቅ እንዳያዘዋውሩ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥቷል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የሀገሪቱን እና የአካባቢውን ደህንነት አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥሉ የገለጸው ጥምረቱ፣ የጀልባ ባለቤቶች ከሁቲዎች ጋር እንዳይተባበሩ አሳስቧል። በሌላ በኩል፣ ጥምረቱ በየመን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ የጦር መሳሪያ የጫነች ጀልባን መቆጣጠሩና ማውደሙ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Gamtaan biyyoota Saudii durfamu kan Yaman keessatti argamu, gareen Huthis meeshaalee waraanaa markabaan seeraan ala akka hin sochoosne akeekkachiiseera. Gochi kun nageenya biyyattii fi naannichaa balaa irra kan buusu ta'uu ibsuun, qabiyyoonni markabootaa garee kana akka hin gargaarre hubachiisaniiru. Kana malees, gamtichi qarqara galaana Yaman keessatti markaba meeshaalee waraanaa fe'atee ture to'annoo jala oolchinee mancaasneerra jedheera.

title: US senator Bernie Sanders slams Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu
english: Senator Bernie Sanders has publicly condemned Donald Trump for supporting Benjamin Netanyahu, claiming this alliance promotes ongoing conflict and suffering in the Middle East. Sanders is urging voters to remove Republicans from power in the upcoming elections to change this trajectory. Furthermore, he is calling for an immediate termination of all military assistance provided to Israel.

oromo: Senator Bernii Saandars deeggarsa Doonaald Tiraamp kan Binyam Neetan yaahuti kennan cimsee balaaleffateera. Saandars tumsi kun naannoo Baha Giddu galeessa keessatti waraanaa fi badii itti fufsiisuu akka danda'u ibsuun, gargaarsi waraanaa Israa'eliif godhamu hundinuu dhaabbachuu qaba jedheera. Kana malees, jijjiirama siyaasaa fiduuf filannoo dhufu irratti paartii Ripabilikaanotaa aangoo irraa kaasuun akka barbaachisu dhaameera.

title: Yemen's Houthis claim six attacks on targets in Saudi Arabia
english: Yemeni Houthi forces recently announced that they launched six separate attacks against targets inside Saudi Arabia. These operations, conducted over a two-day period, involved the use of drones along with both ballistic and cruise missiles. The group claims these strikes are part of their ongoing military campaign.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ባለፉት ሁለት ቀናት ውስጥ በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ ስድስት የተለያዩ ጥቃቶችን መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት በድሮኖች፣ በባለስቲክ ሚሳይሎች እና በክሩዝ ሚሳይሎች አማካኝነት ነው። ቡድኑ ጥቃቶቹን ያከናወነው እንደ ቀጣይ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ አካል እንደሆነ ገልጿል።
oromo: Humnoonni Huutii kan Yemen darban guyyoota lama keessatti biyya Saudii Arabiyaa irratti weerara jaha geggeessuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Humni kun weerara kanaaf xiyyoota diroonii, misaa'eloota balistii fi kruz fayyadamaniiru. Gareen kun weerarri kun duula waraanaa isaanii kan itti fufe keessaa tokko ta'uu ibseera.

title: Hegseth meets Netanyahu during unannounced visit to Israel, Axios reports
english: US Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth traveled to Israel for an unscripted meeting with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu this Monday. Although the visit was not previously announced, news outlets have confirmed the occurrence of the discussion. Official representatives from the United States and Israel have not provided any public statements regarding the details of the encounter.
amharic: የአሜሪካው መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ፒት ሄግሴዝ ሰኞ ዕለት እስራኤልን ባልታቀደ ጉብኝት ጎብኝተው ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ጋር ተወያይተዋል። የዚህ ጉብኝት መደረግ በብዙ የዜና አውታሮች የተረጋገጠ ቢሆንም፣ በይፋ አስቀድሞ ይፋ አልተደረገም ነበር። እስካሁን ድረስ ሁለቱም ወገኖች ስለ ስብሰባው ዝርዝር መረጃ ከመስጠት ተቆጥበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Ameerikaa Pit Heegseet Dilbata darbe gara Israa'el imaluun muummee ministiraa Benjaamin Netaanyaahuu waliin mari'ataniiru. Imalli kun duraan kan hin beekamne yoo ta'u, miidiyaaleen gurguddoon mariin kun gaggeeffamuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru. Mootummoonni lamaanuu waa'ee marii kanaa ilaalchisee hanga ammaatti ibsa kennuu hin barbaanne.

title: Israeli fighter jets spotted over Syria, Iraq, local sources say
english: Local reports indicate that Israeli military aircraft have been observed flying over regions in both Syria and Iraq. The jets were specifically noted in southern and eastern parts of Syria, as well as the Muthanna province in Iraq. These sightings suggest increased aerial activity across these territories.
amharic: የአካባቢው ምንጮች እንደገለጹት የእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በሶሪያ እና በኢራቅ ሰማይ ላይ ታይተዋል። አውሮፕላኖቹ በሶሪያ ደቡባዊ እና ምስራቃዊ ክፍሎች እንዲሁም በኢራቅ ሙታና ግዛት ውስጥ እንደታዩ ተዘግቧል። ይህ ክስተት በእነዚህ አካባቢዎች የአየር እንቅስቃሴ መጨመሩን ያሳያል።
oromo: Maddi oduu naannichaa akka ibsetti, xiyyaarri waraana Israaʼel qilleensa biyyoota Suuriyaa fi Iraaq irra ooluun isaanii mulʼateera. Xiyyaarotni kunneen kutaalee Suuriyaa kibbaa fi bahaa akkasumas naannoo Muthaanaa kan Iraaq keessatti ilaalameera. Gochi kun naannolee kanneenitti sochiin xiyyaara waraanaa dabaluu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Tennis star Svitolina says emotional toll of Ukraine war led to Monfils separation
english: Ukrainian tennis player Elina Svitolina has announced her separation from her husband, Gaël Monfils, explaining that the emotional trauma caused by the war in her home country made it impossible to maintain their marriage. She stated that she needs time to heal and rediscover herself, emphasizing that the decision was incredibly difficult. Despite their breakup, the couple intends to continue co-parenting their daughter, Skai, whom they prioritize above all else.
amharic: የዩክሬኗ የቴኒስ ኮከብ ኤሊና ስቪቶሊና በሀገሯ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት ባደረሰባት የስነ-ልቦና ጫና ምክንያት ከባለቤቷ ጋኤል ሞንፊልስ ጋር መለያየቷን አስታውቃለች። ስቪቶሊና በጦርነቱ ምክንያት የደረሰባትን የውስጥ ቀውስ ለመቋቋም እና ራሷን ለመፈለግ ይህንን ከባድ ውሳኔ መወሰኗን ገልጻለች። ጥንዶቹ ጋብቻቸውን ቢፈቱም፣ ስካይ ለምትባለው ሴት ልጃቸው የጋራ የወላጅነት ሃላፊነታቸውን እንደሚወጡ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Taphattuun tenisii Yukreen Elina Svitoliinaan, waraana biyya ishee keessatti adeemsifamaa jiruun miidhaan sammuu ishee irra ga'e hiriyummaa gaa'elaa ishee Ga'eel Monfils wajjin qabdu akka dhaabbatu godheera jechuun beeksifteetti. Svitoliinaan miira hir'inaa keessoo ishee keessatti uumamee fi of deebifachuuf yeroo akka ishee barbaachisu ibsiteetti. Gaa'ela isaanii kan diigan ta'us, mucayyoo isaanii Skai jedhamtu karaa waliin guddifachuuf walii galaniiru.

title: Exiled critic of Rwandan president found beheaded
english: Robert Kabera, a former Rwandan soldier and vocal critic of President Paul Kagame who lived in exile in Uganda, was discovered murdered and decapitated near Kampala. The 50-year-old YouTuber and musician had previously fled his home country citing political persecution. His brutal death has raised significant concerns among other Rwandan dissidents living abroad regarding their personal safety and security.
amharic: በኡጋንዳ በስደት ይኖሩ የነበሩት የቀድሞ የሩዋንዳ ወታደር እና የፕሬዚዳንት ፖል ካጋሜ ተቺ የሆኑት ሮበርት ካቤራ በካምፓላ አቅራቢያ አንገታቸው ተቀልቶ ተገኝተዋል። የ50 ዓመቱ የዩቲዩብ አቅራቢ እና ሙዚቀኛ ከዚህ ቀደም የፖለቲካ ስደት ደርሶብኛል በሚል ከሀገራቸው ወጥተው ነበር። ይህ አሰቃቂ ግድያ በውጭ ሀገራት በሚኖሩ የሩዋንዳ ተቃዋሚዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ የደህንነት ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Raawwandaa keessaa baqatee Ugaandaa keessa jiraachaa kan ture, loltuu durii fi mormaa pirezidaant Paawul Kaagaamee kan ture Roobert Kaaberaa, magaalaa Kaampaalaa cinaatti mataan isaa muramee du'ee argame. Nama waggaa 50 kanaa fi yeroo baayyee miidiyaa Yuutiyubii irratti yaada isaa ibsaa ture, kanaan dura biyyasaa keessatti ari’atama siyaasaa waan isa mudateef baqatee ture. Ajjeechaan kun baqattota Raawwandaa biyya alaa jiraatan hunda biratti sodaa nageenyaa guddaa uumee jira.

title: Egyptian parliament delays vote on military support for Saudi Arabia
english: The Egyptian parliament has postponed its decision on whether to deploy military support to Saudi Arabia following recent attacks by Houthi rebels. Lawmakers delayed the vote until October 26, citing a need for greater clarity regarding the mission's scope, costs, and potential risks. While President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi has promised to defend Gulf allies, some political parties are hesitant, demanding more information before approving the deployment.
amharic: የግብፅ ፓርላማ በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ከደረሰው ጥቃት ጋር በተያያዘ ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ ለማድረግ ታቅዶ የነበረውን ውሳኔ አስተላልፏል። የህግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤቱ የውትድርና ተልዕኮውን ዝርዝር ሁኔታ፣ ወጪ እና ስጋቶች በተመለከተ በቂ መረጃ እንደሌለ በመጥቀስ ድምጽ መስጠቱን እስከ ጥቅምት 26 ቀን አራዝሞታል። ምንም እንኳን ፕሬዝዳንት አብዱልፈታህ አል-ሲሲ የባህረ ሰላጤ አጋሮቻቸውን ለመከላከል ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ የተወሰኑ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ውሳኔው ከመጽደቁ በፊት ግልጽ የሆነ መረጃ እንዲሰጥ እየጠየቁ ነው።
oromo: Mana maree Gibxii, haleellaa garee Huutii irratti erga raawwatamee booda waraana Saudii Arabiyaaf gargaarsa gochuun ni danda'ama jedhamee kan eegamu murtee isaa dabarseera. Miseensonni mana maree kun, galii fi balaa waraana kanaa ilaalchisee odeeffannoon ga’aan akka hin jirre ibsuun, murtee isaanii hanga guyyaa Muddee 26tti dabarsaniiru. Prezidaant Abdel Fattah el-Sisi gargaarsa kana kennuuf fedhii kan qaban ta'us, gareewwan siyaasaa tokko tokko ergaa fi baasii waraana kanaa irratti iftoomni akka jiraatu gaafachaa jiru.

title: 160 people reported killed in escalating drone attacks across Sudan
english: Escalating drone attacks in Sudan have resulted in over 160 civilian deaths in recent days, with both government forces and the Rapid Support Forces blamed for the violence. These strikes have targeted markets, transport hubs, and areas housing displaced people, causing widespread destruction and loss of life. The United Nations has formally condemned the strikes, noting that the increased use of unmanned aircraft is causing an alarming surge in civilian casualties and damaging vital infrastructure.
amharic: በሱዳን እየተባባሰ በመጣው የድሮን ጥቃት ባለፉት ጥቂት ቀናት ውስጥ ከ160 በላይ ንጹሃን ዜጎች መሞታቸው ተገለጸ። ጥቃቶቹ በመንግስት ጦር እና በፍጥነት በሚንቀሳቀሱ የድጋፍ ሃይሎች (RSF) መካከል የሚደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በገበያ ስፍራዎች እና ተፈናቃዮች በሚኖሩባቸው አካባቢዎች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ናቸው። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ድሮኖቹ በንጹሃን ዜጎች እና በህጻናት ላይ እያደረሱ ያለውን ጉዳት በማውገዝ ስጋቱን ገልጿል።
oromo: Sudan keessatti haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) guyyoota darban keessa dabalaa dhufeen lubbuun namoota 160 ol darbeera. Haleellaan kunneen waraana mootummaafi garee RSF gidduutti kan gaggeeffamu yoo ta'u, bakkeewwan gabaafi iddoowwan namoonni buqqa'an keessa jiraatan irratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii haleellaa kana balaaleffachuudhaan, fayyadamiinsi drone kanneenii lubbuu namoota nagaafi daa'immanii akka galaafataa jiru ibseera.

title: Could your halal pension be funding Israel’s military?
english: Concerns have been raised regarding a Sharia-compliant pension fund managed by HSBC that invested over $100 million into corporations associated with the Israeli military. This discovery has prompted many Muslims to question whether their retirement savings are unintentionally supporting military actions. The situation highlights the challenges of ensuring financial products remain aligned with ethical and religious principles.
amharic: ኤች ኤስ ቢ ሲ (HSBC) የሚያስተዳድረው የሸሪዓ ህግን የተከተለ የጡረታ ፈንድ ከ100 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ዘርፍ ተሳትፎ ባላቸው ኩባንያዎች ላይ ኢንቨስት ማድረጉ አነጋጋሪ ሆኗል። ይህ ግኝት የሙስሊም ተቀማጮች የጡረታ ገንዘብ ሳያውቁት ወታደራዊ ድርጊቶችን እየደገፈ ይሆን ወይ የሚል ጥያቄ አስነስቷል። ጉዳዩ የፋይናንስ ምርቶች ከሃይማኖታዊ እና ስነ-ምግባራዊ መርሆዎች ጋር ተጣጥመው እንዲቀጥሉ ማድረግ ያለውን ፈተና ያሳያል።
oromo: Baankiin HSBC qabeenya maallaqa sooramaa Shari'aa irratti hundaa'e tokko irratti, biyyoota waraana Israa'el deggaran irratti doolaara miiliyoona 100 ol gubbachuun isaa mormii kaaseera. Dhugaan kunis namoonni Muslimaa maallaqni isaanii osoo hin beekin waraanaaf oolaa jiraachuu isaatiin yaaddoo keessa akka galan taasiseera. Kunis qabeenyi fi invastimantiin namootaa seera amantii fi safuu wajjin wal simatee deemuu isaa mirkaneeffachuun akka nama rakkisu mul'isa.

title: Israeli police say they arrested 10 in connection with settler attacks
english: Israeli authorities have taken ten individuals into custody following recent violent acts committed by settlers in the occupied West Bank. Among the incidents involving these suspects was an assault on a photographer from the Washington Post and the targeting of European diplomatic staff. Police confirmed the arrests by releasing video footage of the operation.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ በሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በተፈጸመው የቅርብ ጊዜ የጥቃት ድርጊት ተጠርጥረው አስር ሰዎች በእስራኤል ፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። ከተፈጸሙት ጥቃቶች መካከል የዋሽንግተን ፖስት ጋዜጠኛን መደብደብ እና በአውሮፓውያን ዲፕሎማቶች ላይ የተሰነዘረው ጥቃት ይገኙበታል። ፖሊስ የተጠርጣሪዎቹን መያዝ የሚያሳይ ምስል ይፋ አድርጓል።
oromo: Poolisiin Israa'el qondaaltota fi jiraattota naannawa West Bank irratti haleellaa raawwataniin walqabatee namoota kudhan ta'an to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Shakkamtoonni kun garee suuraa kaasu kan Washington Post miidhuu fi bakka bu'oota dippiloomaasii Awurooppaa irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaaniitiin himatamu. Poolisiin mallattoo to'annaa jala oolchuu isaanii ibsuuf viidiyoo gadi lakkiseera.

title: Trump approval hits record-low 31 percent, polls show Republican struggles
english: A recent Reuters/Ipsos poll shows President Donald Trump’s approval rating has dropped to a historic low of 31 percent. This decline is largely attributed to economic strain and rising fuel costs following the conflict between the U.S. and Iran. Consequently, the Republican Party is trailing the Democrats by 12 points in general congressional ballot polling ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ የሮይተርስ/ኢፕሶስ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው የፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ተወዳጅነት ወደ ታሪካዊ ዝቅተኛ ደረጃ ማለትም 31 በመቶ ወርዷል። ይህ የድጋፍ መቀነስ በዋናነት በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል በተፈጠረው ግጭት ሳቢያ በተከሰተው የኢኮኖሚ ጫና እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ መጨመር ምክንያት እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። በዚህም የተነሳ፣ በመጪው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ከዴሞክራቶች በ12 ነጥብ በልጦ እየተከተለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Qorannoon dhihoo kun akka agarsiisutti, fudhatamummaan pirezidaant Donald Traamp gara sadarkaa seenaa keessatti mul'ate hin beekne, kan ta'e 31% irratti gadi bu'eera. Gadi bu'iinsi kun kan dhufe waraana Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduutti ka'een walqabatee rakkoo diinagdee fi daballii gatii boba'aan kan maddu dha. Kana bu'uura godhachuun, paartin Ripaablikaanotaa filannoo giddu-galeessa fuuldura jiruun paartii Demokraatonni irraa dhibbeentaa 12n duubatti hafee jira.

title: Australian MP critically injured after being hit by car in apparent attack
english: Independent Australian MP Helen Haines is in critical condition after being struck by a vehicle outside her office in Wangaratta. Authorities have arrested a 43-year-old man at the scene and are investigating the incident as a potential intentional attack. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese condemned the violence, noting that threats against politicians in the country have been increasing.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ ፓርላማ አባል ሄለን හේንስ በዋንጋራታ በሚገኘው ቢሯቸው ውጭ በመኪና ተገጭተው ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው በሆስፒታል ይገኛሉ። ፖሊስ የ43 ዓመት አዛውንትን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋለ ሲሆን ድርጊቱ ሆን ተብሎ የተፈጸመ ጥቃት ሊሆን እንደሚችል እየመረመረ ነው። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንቶኒ አልባኒዝ በፖለቲከኞች ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶች እየጨመሩ መምጣታቸውን በመግለጽ ድርጊቱን አውግዘዋል።
oromo: miseensi mana maree Awustiraaliyaa Helen Heens waajjira isaanii kan Wangaraataa dura konkolaataan erga isaan buuseen booda miidhaan cimaan irra gahee hospitaala seeraanii jiru. Poolisiin namicha umuriin isaa 43 ta'e to'annoo jala oolcheera, akkasumas gochi kun haleellaa yaadamee ta'uu isaa qorachaa jira. Muummeen Ministiraa Antoonii Albaaniiz haleellaa kana balaaleffachuun, biyyattii keessatti siyaasaarratti miidhaan geessisuu fi sodaachisuun dabalaa dhufuu isaa ibsaniiru.

title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support says court filing
english: A former OpenAI engineer, Abdulrahman Alfozan, faces charges for allegedly hiding a recording device in a company conference room. US prosecutors claim Alfozan had significant backing from the Saudi government, noting that a military official paid for his family's one-way tickets to leave the country after his arrest. Because high-level meetings occurred in that room, officials argue this case involves national security concerns and that the suspect is a significant flight risk.
amharic: የቀድሞው የOpenAI መሐንዲስ አብዱልረህማን አልፎዛን በኩባንያው የስብሰባ አዳራሽ ውስጥ የመቅረጫ መሳሪያ በመደበቅ ተከሷል። የአሜሪካ አቃቤ ህግ አልፎዛን የሳዑዲ መንግስት ድጋፍ እንደነበረው በመግለጽ፣ ከአሰሩት በኋላ የቤተሰቡ የአንድ አቅጣጫ የበረራ ትኬት በሳዑዲ ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣን እንደተከፈለ ጠቁመዋል። በስብሰባው ክፍል ውስጥ የከፍተኛ ደረጃ ውይይቶች ይደረጉ ስለነበር፣ ጉዳዩ የሀገር ደህንነት ስጋት እንደሚፈጥር እና ተጠርጣሪው ከአገር የመሸሽ ዕድሉ ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Injineerri duraanii OpenAI kan ta'an Abdulrahman Alfozan, kutaa walgahii keessatti meeshaa sagalee waraabu dhoksuun himataman. Abbaan alangaa Ameerikaa akka jedhutti, Alfozan mootummaa Saudii irraa deggarsa guddaa kan qabu yoo ta'u, erga inni qabamee booda maatiin isaa gara biyya isaaniitti akka deebi'anuf tikkeetiin xiyyaaraa ajajaa waraana Saudiin kaffalameera. Kutaa sana keessatti mariin sadarkaa olaanaa waan taasifamaa tureef, dhimmi kun nageenya biyyaa waliin kan wal qabatu fi shakkamaan kun biyyaa baqachuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: Netanyahu’s new security doctrine: Regional strategy or election ploy?
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has introduced a new national security strategy that emphasizes preemptive military strikes and stronger regional partnerships. Released shortly before upcoming elections, critics suggest the move is intended to boost his image as a security-focused leader while he faces political instability and corruption charges. Additionally, Netanyahu cited concerns about potential future shifts in US foreign policy as a primary reason for Israel to seek independent, self-reliant defense capabilities.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የቅድመ ጥቃት ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎችን እና የቀጠናዊ ትብብርን የሚያጠናክር አዲስ የብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ስትራቴጂ ይፋ አድርገዋል። ይህ ሰነድ በምርጫ ወቅት የወጣ በመሆኑ ተንታኞች ኔታንያሁ በፖለቲካዊ ችግሮች እና በሙስና ክሶች እየተፈተኑ ባሉበት ወቅት የደኅንነት መጠበቂያ ኃይል ለመምሰል የሚጠቀሙበት ስልት እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። በተጨማሪም ኔታንያሁ በአሜሪካ የውጭ ፖሊሲ ላይ ለወደፊቱ ሊመጡ የሚችሉ ለውጦችን በመፍራት እስራኤል በራሷ አቅም መከላከል እንዳለባት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaanhuu tarsiimoo nageenya biyyoolessaa haaraa tarkaanfii waraanaa duraa fi walta'iinsa naannawaa irratti xiyyeeffatu ifa godhaniiru. Tarsiimoon kun filannoo dura ba'uun isaa, hayyoonni akka yaadanitti, Netanyaanhuun rakkoo siyaasaa fi himannaa malaammaltummaa keessa utuu jiranuufiif akka gaggeessaa nageenya biyyattiitti of mul'isuuf kan itti fayyadaman ta'uu agarsiisa. title: Ronaldo banned for 30 days, fined $285 by Portugal over spat with Jesus
english: Cristiano Ronaldo has received a 30-day suspension and a $285 fine from the Portuguese Football Association for abandoning the national team camp. The conflict arose after the star player disagreed with coach Jorge Jesus regarding his playing time during the Nations League. Although Ronaldo has apologized for his actions and left his future with the team open, he must now serve this disciplinary penalty.
